// Quoting, variables and expansion.
$ echo hello   world
hello world
$ echo "a  b" 'c $HOME' $HOME
a  b c $HOME /root
$ echo "double \"quoted\" \$HOME" 'single \n'
double "quoted" $HOME single \n
$ echo a\ b\\c
a b\c
$ echo 'unterminated
> 
sh: syntax error: unterminated quoted string
[exit 2]
$ X=5; echo "x=$X" ${X} ${Y:-default} ${#HOME}
x=5 5 default 5
$ X=1 env | grep '^X='
X=1
$ unset X; echo "[$X]"
[]
$ echo $SHELL $USER $HOME $PWD $0
/bin/sh root /root /root -sh
$ false; echo $?
1
$ nosuch; echo $?
sh: nosuch: not found
127
$ f=/tmp/dir/file.tar.gz; echo ${f##*/} ${f#*/} ${f%.*} ${f%%.*}
file.tar.gz tmp/dir/file.tar.gz /tmp/dir/file.tar /tmp/dir/file
$ echo ${UNSET-dflt} ${HOME:+set} ${N:=assigned} $N
dflt set assigned assigned
$ echo ${UNSET:?is required}
sh: UNSET: is required
[exit 2]

// Command substitution and arithmetic.
$ echo $(echo nested) `echo tick`
nested tick
$ echo "$(echo a; echo b)"
a
b
$ echo $((2 + 3 * 4)) $((10 / 3)) $((7 % 4)) $((1 < 2))
14 3 3 1
$ echo $((1 / 0))
sh: divide by zero
[exit 2]
$ echo $((1 +))
sh: arithmetic syntax error
[exit 2]

// Globbing.
$ echo /etc/pass*
/etc/passwd
$ echo /etc/nothing*
/etc/nothing*
$ echo '/etc/pass*'
/etc/pass*

// Not ash: these are bash features, and fail the way ash fails on them.
$ echo $RANDOM $BASH_VERSION $UID
136

$ a=(1 2 3)
sh: syntax error: unexpected "("
[exit 2]
$ echo ${a[0]}
sh: syntax error: bad substitution
[exit 2]
$ echo ${!HOME}
sh: syntax error: bad substitution
[exit 2]
$ echo ${HOME/root/x}
/x
$ f() { echo hi; }
$ function f { echo hi; }
$ cat <(echo hi)
sh: syntax error: unexpected "("
[exit 2]
$ [[ 1 == 1 ]] && echo yes
yes

// ash's bash extensions and arithmetic.
$ x=abcdef; echo ${x:1:3} ${x:4} ${x: -2} ${x/cd/-} ${x//[ace]/.} ${x/#ab/AB} ${x/%ef/EF}
bcd ef ef ab-ef .b.d.f ABcdef abcdEF
$ echo $'a\tb\x41' $'it\'s'
a	bA it's
$ echo $((1<<4 | 1)) $((2**10)) $((7>3 ? 1 : 0)) $((~0 & 255)); i=1; : $((i+=4)); echo $i $((i++)) $i
17 1024 1 255
5 5 6
$ set -- a 'b c'; for a in "$@"; do echo "[$a]"; done; set --; for a in "$@"; do echo none; done; echo end
[a]
[b c]
end
$ x=$(false); echo $?; y=$(true); echo $?
1
0
$ echo ${#RANDOM} | grep -c '^[1-5]$'
1
$ echo "$PS1|$PS2|$PS4|$OPTIND"
\w \$ |> |+ |1
